shellPreamble: Every verification shell starts with `set -o pipefail` and `export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1` (conventions section 7), then `EV=tmp/telescreen-gdp-20261031-h4/gdp-p10-cmd-e2e/attempt-<n>; mkdir -p "$EV"`. sharedFileOwnership.rule: gdp-p10 writes only its writePaths; sharedPaths is empty. Workers never edit this manifest, the h1/h2/h3 manifests, impl-plans/README.md, design-docs/**, mise.toml, .gitignore, .gitleaks.toml, src/**, db/**, tests/e2e/harness.py, the contract schemas, pyproject.toml, uv.lock or any accepted dependency's files. Workers never run go get, go mod tidy or go mod vendor, and never run git checkout, restore, stash, reset, clean, commit, add or push. Per-edit discipline: read the file fresh before each edit, record pre/post SHA-256 under EV, and file a Reconciliation request instead of overwriting a file whose hash changed outside the worker's own edits.
sharedFileOwnership.dependencies: No new Go or Python dependency and no lockfile change. The E2E uses only declared dependencies (uvicorn, PyJWT, cryptography, the stdlib http.server) and the vendored Go module.
sharedFileOwnership.reconciliation: A defect in an accepted plan's file is a Reconciliation request in the gdp-p10 Progress Log, reproduced by a failing test id. Serial finalization reproduces it and fixes the root cause in the owning plan's paths.

constraints: Conform to contract 1.2 as published; contract gaps are open questions (design section 14, user-qa file), never schema edits.
No raw secret or content value leaves the worker: masked_snippet only; every result string passes the Bureau Redactor; logs never print content, permission e-mails, file names or tokens.
Credentials only from env vars or files named by env vars. The E2E generates its RSA key at run time into tmp_path; no committed credentials, keys or real tenant identifiers.

Python code follows the python-coding-standards skill and typelint (no Any/object/dict/**kwargs, dataclasses/enums, no type: ignore; env built as list[tuple[str, str]] and converted inline). No touched file reaches 1000 lines.
Go code is gofmt-clean and go vet clean, with no package-level mutable state.
All verification is offline with fakes. Skip-only commands are not evidence. A missing go binary in the E2E is pytest.fail, never a skip. Non-test greps never contain the Python test-runner word.
Every wait in the E2E is bounded; the worker subprocess, uvicorn server and fake HTTP server are torn down in finally.
The E2E binary is built only at go/bin/telescreen-gdrive-police-e2e; never under tmp_path or another repository path.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Pull-mode Police worker over contract 1.2, because the Bureau never imports out-of-process code (design overview).

The E2E serves the real harness app with uvicorn.Server on port 0 in the test's event loop (design section 15). The fallback is a dedicated app built from the same wiring in e2e_fakes.py; whichever is used is recorded in the gdp-p10 Progress Log.
go-lint lists files with find instead of go list -f '{{.Dir}}', because mise renders task scripts with Tera (owner repair 2026-10-31, design section 11).
Only 404 maps to gone; 410 is a fetch failure (owner decision V1, 2026-10-30).
The E2E estate keeps every shard at resources_failed = 0, so exposures and inventories are applied (design 8.1); G1/V3 degradation is avoided by construction.

The E2E binary lives in the go/bin artifact root, and uv build goes to /tmp/telescreen-gdp-p10-dist, so no build output leaves the declared artifact boundary (owner resolution run 3 -> run 4, design sections 10 and 16).
intentionalTradeoffs: uvicorn.Server on port 0 is preferred over the dedicated fallback app, because it exercises the real harness wiring; the fallback is kept for sandbox loopback limits (design section 15).
go-lint uses find-based gofmt -l plus go vet ./... instead of go list templates, because mise renders task scripts with Tera (owner repair, design section 11).
410 is treated as a fetch failure rather than gone (owner decision V1), at the cost of differing from the workflowInput targetScope item (3) wording.
Only the rule detector is ported; ML and LLM detectors stay Python-only.

The workflow CI gate replaces only the final build step with uv build --out-dir /tmp/telescreen-gdp-p10-dist; the literal mise run ci is an owner step after the workflow (owner resolution run 3 -> run 4).
supportedEdgeCases: A file that returns 404 and a trashed file end with no open issue.
Sheets inventories report kind table with item_count 3; Drive and Docs inventories report kind file.
Domain-wide delegation: the token server sees both the user and the admin subjects.
run() exit codes: 2 for configuration errors, 3 for unauthorized enrollment.
rate_limited responses honor retry_after_seconds; long-poll claims and heartbeats with lease extension and cancellation.
A missing go binary in the E2E is pytest.fail, never a skip; SQLite 'database is locked' falls back to concurrency 2, recorded in the Progress Log.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Live Google Workspace tenants and real credentials.
Shard-wide G1/V3 degradation when resources_failed > 0 (pending owner acceptance in design-docs/user-qa/pending-go-gdrive-police-contract-gaps.md).
The Drive changes feed, watch channels and push mode (D6).
residualRisks: E2E timing: FakeClock leases, long-poll claims and SQLite concurrency (independent_sessions=True; lower concurrency to 2 if 'database is locked' appears and record it).
uvicorn on port 0 inside the node sandbox loopback; the design 15 fallback exists.
The CI-equivalent sequence wall-clock now includes go-test, go-build and the E2E subprocess build; commands run in the foreground with bounded timeouts.
The literal mise run ci (with uv build into dist/) is not run inside the workflow; the owner runs it afterwards.
GDP-R5-L1 and GDP-R5-L2 remain low residuals; G1/V3 shard-wide degradation is pending owner acceptance in user-qa.
